name: Memory Codesight
description: Expose .codesight artifacts as an additive memory corpus supplement.

rootDir.label: Codesight Root
rootDir.help: Relative or absolute path to the codesight artifact root.

limits.maxResults.label: Max Results
limits.maxResults.help: Hard cap for codesight supplement search results.

limits.maxSnippetChars.label: Max Snippet Chars
limits.maxSnippetChars.help: Maximum snippet chars returned per codesight result.

limits.maxFileBytes.label: Max File Bytes
limits.maxFileBytes.help: Skip artifact files larger than this size.

limits.maxFilesPerQuery.label: Max Files Per Query
limits.maxFilesPerQuery.help: Maximum number of artifact files considered per query.

staleAfterHours.label: Stale After Hours
staleAfterHours.help: Mark artifacts stale when older than this many hours.
